folds.body:
F1: R9/FA14 preserves distinct resident shifts, separate output collection, downstream use, toolkit exclusivity, facility construction, invitation/service, warned frost and nursery renewal. One connected slice cannot close these other leaves. Its desired resident route was later reported unavailable: next opening 726 played minutes away against a 120-minute outer ceiling, with no PLAY or spending; that local dependency result is not an external project blocker. The 8 definition/projection plus 1 scheduler check, seven-group literal restoration and accidental shared-cwd build corrected by isolated rebuild are scoped historical evidence. R8 negative trial persistence does not establish identification, control, dog or feat positives; 108/100 plus 35 lost debit remains the failed attempt record.

F2: R10/FA15 treats physical harness costs, grip self-guard, balance versus rope escapes, maintained brace, finite pads/lashings, marked-fitting recipe and supply conduct as distinct function-changing leaves. F4/Reedbank proof does not cover them all. Its criterion ledger separates SOURCE, current native, historical native and director/spec. Final persistence is required for changed earned state, but untouched groups need no ceremonial cycle. Later R11 records override the prospective acceptance language: paid pad/guard/incoming hook was bounded partial, completed/used snapshots were not pending-job proof, withdrawal was ambiguous and final Export was lost. No budget pass or successful recovery follows.

F3: R11/FA18 targets an actual paid help cause, retained legitimate consequence and useful later action with finite cost/result. Historical helped counts must not retroactively mint tickets; preview/load/re-entry cannot reroll contact, refill stock or settle twice. The schema-1 baseline and no useful consequence are observations to verify at that earlier point, superseded by the later reported schema-2 ticket/bread implementation. Its 15-minute contact attempts, 20-to-50 percent chance and daily cap are historical balance, not fresh current-source findings or universal design constraints. It allowed a narrow new local-life action when reuse did not fit, without a second framework. Later R12–R14 reports preserve SOURCE implementation but zero-paid error-stopped native attempt and missing natural cause/use/export proof.

These are retained historical contracts, not present launch instructions. Fixed gross-action budgets include refunded reservations, ambiguous commitments and cleanup; later attempt results govern what was actually achieved. An independent fresh journey, where historically allowed, cannot be called recovery or replay of lost paid state. Current project rules and selected authority govern future verification, not archived process IDs, expected branches, UI locators or writer-transfer records. No runtime files or saved games were inspected or changed in this review.
